description: Inferred authority, user, partner and public-beneficiary relationships. Residents do not subscribe to Twyns and fine income is not modeled as supplier revenue.

relationTypes.name: Financial
relationTypes.description: Reserved for explicit monetary flows; no unverified fine or commission flow is modeled.

relations.name: Commission parking operations
relations.description: The authority commissions service outcomes; vendor fees and parking sanctions are separate economic flows.

relations.name: Set accountable field priorities
relations.description: The authority assigns remit and service priorities rather than leaving software to set enforcement policy.

relations.name: Deliver observations and evidence
relations.description: The reviewer receives a purpose-appropriate dossier and returns incomplete records.

relations.name: Review parking decisions and corrections
relations.description: Reviewed parking outcomes and challenges require proper authority and reasons.

relations.name: Report concerns and receive outcomes
relations.description: Public contact uses the authority relationship, with permitted information and assisted alternatives.

relations.name: Submit relevant response evidence
relations.description: A resident or recipient responds through the appropriate authority process.

relations.name: Coordinate specialist crews
relations.description: Transport procedures and operating-area briefing frame the assigned work.

relations.name: Agree interface acceptance
relations.description: The contracting authority agrees interfaces, source access and service boundaries with delivery partners.

relations.name: Define processing and access conditions
relations.description: The authority reviewer checks purpose and evidence before new interface scope is enabled.

relations.name: Review controlled case-information use
relations.description: Case use and disclosure remain aligned with purpose, authority and lifecycle rules.

relations.name: Reconcile scan and rights-source disruption
relations.description: Operating and technical owners share incident scope and recovery outcome.

relations.name: Resolve authority-side control responsibilities
relations.description: The authority assigns accountable control owners; supplier audit evidence is one input.
